company.name: Checkmk
company.tagline: The IT monitoring platform. Scalable. Automated. Extensible.
company.description:
Checkmk is a full-stack IT monitoring and observability platform that gives you broad and deep visibility across your entire hybrid stack, whether it's cloud, on-premises, or a mix of both. Infrastructure, applications, and user experience, all in one platform.

We power the mission-critical IT backbone for some of the world's most largest organizations who serve billions of people every day, and for them, IT availability and reliability are non-negotiable.

Our story started in 2009 as an open-source project with a clear mission: make IT monitoring faster, more robust, and more efficient. Since then, we've kept pushing at the boundaries of what next-generation monitoring can look like.

Over 5,000 customers and 300 partners across 50+ countries trust Checkmk as their standard for IT monitoring and observability.
